title: Physics consistent conditional flow matching model as a plasma physics surrogate model
title_zh: 作为等离子体物理替代模型的物理一致条件流匹配模型
summary: 稳态系统的基于物理的替代建模经常面临数据稀缺和软惩罚损失导致的优化不稳定的问题。与在训练过程中依赖于显式的、可微的 PDE 残差的主流物理生成方法不同，我们的框架针对的是闭式控制方程不可用或不可微的系统。我们引入了一个统一的连续时间条件流匹配（CFM）框架，用于替代建模和稀疏数据同化，并在低温等离子体动力学上进行评估。通过将数据相关插值与动态屏蔽相结合，我们的方法可以在单个架构中处理无条件预测和缺失数据插补。
abstract: Physics-informed surrogate modeling for steady-state systems often struggles with data scarcity and optimization instabilities from soft penalty losses. Unlike prevailing physics-informed generative methods that rely on explicit, differentiable PDE residuals during training, our framework targets systems where closed-form governing equations are unavailable or non-differentiable. We introduce a unified continuous-time conditional flow matching (CFM) framework for surrogate modeling and sparse data assimilation, evaluated on low-temperature plasma dynamics. By combining data-dependent interpolants with dynamic masking, our approach handles unconditioned prediction and missing-data imputation within a single architecture. We replace standard velocity matching with a direct state-prediction ( -prediction) objective, eliminating variance-induced sampling inefficiencies in deterministic regimes. For inference, the formulation supports both time-dependent ODE integration (CFM- ) and an autonomous regime (CFM- ) that enables measurement conditioning via anchor substitution. Global conservation laws are enforced via post-hoc geometric projections rather than loss regularizers. Results show that both CFM variants achieve superior accuracy, sample efficiency under data scarcity, and raw physical consistency over standard regressors. Furthermore, macroscopic constraints alone yield negligible reductions in test error, confirming the necessity of a data-driven generative prior over the physical manifold.

title: Machine Learning Assisted Design of Complex and High Entropy Alloys by Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD Process for Low Carbon Energy Applications in Extreme Environments
title_zh: 通过混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺机器学习辅助设计复杂高熵合金，用于极端环境中的低碳能源应用
summary: 复杂和高熵合金由于其在恶劣环境下的机械和耐腐蚀性能而备受关注，特别是无碳能源应用所需的性能。然而，由于其复杂性和鸡尾酒效应，通过试错方法以散装和薄膜形式进行加工是不切实际的。人工智能的最新发展为其属性的阐述和调整带来了新的可能性。首先，我们概述材料和数据科学研究。然后，我们描述了 DIADEM（法国材料和数据科学融合倡议）如何通过开发全国性的合成和表征平台网络（DIADEM 发现中心）来解决无碳能源应用（核、高温电解等）创新涂层的开发问题。
abstract: arXiv:2608.01903v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex and high entropy alloys are attracting much attention currently thanks to their mechanical and corrosion resistance properties in harsh environments, in particular needed for carbon-free energy applications. However, their elaboration in bulk and in thin film form in a trial-and-error approach is impractical due to their complexity and the cocktail effect. The recent development of artificial intelligence brings a new possibility for their elaboration and adjustment of their properties. Firstly, we present an overview of Materials and data science research. Then we describe how DIADEM - French initiative for Materials and Data science convergence - tackles the development of innovative coatings for carbon-free energy applications (nuclear, high temperature electrolysis, ...) thanks to the development of a nationwide network of synthesis and characterization platforms - the DIADEM discovery hub. We describe in particular DIADEM-2D, an AI-driven Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD process using 4 cathodes in confocal combinatorial configuration. We present the high entropy alloy determination using data from the literature for corrosion resistance in molten salt media and nuclear accidental conditions. An element-independent model gathering deposition parameters and coating properties has been implemented allowing the design of protective coatings with a particular composition. We demonstrate the feasibility of this process and its accuracy.

title: AI-Guided Computational Design of a Room-Temperature, Ambient- Pressure Superconductor Candidate: Grokene
title_zh: 室温、常压超导体候选物的人工智能引导计算设计：Grokene
summary: 我们介绍了 Grokene，一种源自石墨烯的新型二维超晶格，它是通过利用大型语言模型的人工智能引导材料发现工作流程来识别的。 Grokene 预计将表现出环境压力、室温超导性，计算模拟显示较高的电子声子耦合常数和相当大的对数平均声子频率（约 1650 K），导致平均场临界温度约为 325 K。完全各向同性的 Eliashberg 解决方案进一步支持 310 K 左右的临界温度，强调了其室温超导的强大潜力。
abstract: arXiv:2601.00931v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Grokene, a novel two-dimensional superlattice derived from graphene, which was identified through an AI-guided materials discovery workflow utilizing a large language model. Grokene is predicted to exhibit ambient-pressure, room-temperature superconductivity, with computational simulations revealing a high electron-phonon coupling constant and a substantial logarithmic-averaged phonon frequency (~1650 K), leading to a mean-field critical temperature of approximately 325 K. Full isotropic Eliashberg solutions further support a critical temperature around 310 K, underscoring its strong potential for room-temperature superconductivity. However, the strict two-dimensional nature of Grokene introduces phase fluctuations, limiting the observable superconducting transition to a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) temperature of about 120 K in monolayers. To elevate TBKT toward room temperature, strategies such as few-layer stacking, substrate or gate engineering, and optimization of superlattice structure and doping levels are proposed. Our integrated workflow, combining AI-driven materials discovery with advanced many-body theories (DFPT/EPW, Eliashberg, and RPA), provides a systematic and reproducible framework for exploring novel superconductors. We suggest that experimental synthesis and comprehensive characterization of Grokene will be essential to assess these computational predictions and to explore routes toward practical superconductivity under ambient pressure.

title: Time-temperature superposition from multi-temperature chirp rheometry of thermorheologically simple materials via physics-informed Gaussian processes
title_zh: 通过物理信息高斯过程对热流变简单材料进行多温度线性调频流变测量的时间-温度叠加
summary: 从瞬态响应数据推断本构定律是软凝聚态物理中的一个中心反问题，特别是当相关弛豫谱超出单个实验的时间窗口时。时间-温度叠加 (TTS) 通过允许温度重新调整特征弛豫时间而不改变弛豫谱的基本形状，从而限制了线性粘弹性区域中热流变简单材料的这个问题。我们将此约束纳入基于物理的机器学习框架中，通过线性调频流变测量实现时间分辨机械光谱。我们将紧凑分数粘弹性模型编码为源自玻尔兹曼叠加原理的因果卷积特征，并使用稀疏变分高斯过程回归联合拟合多温度线性调频记录。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inferring constitutive laws from transient response data is a central inverse problem in soft condensed-matter physics, particularly when the relevant relaxation spectrum extends beyond the time window of a single experiment. Time-temperature superposition (TTS) constrains this problem for thermorheologically simple materials in the linear viscoelastic regime by allowing temperature to rescale the characteristic relaxation time without changing the underlying shape of the relaxation spectrum. We incorporate this constraint into a physics-informed machine-learning framework for time-resolved mechanical spectroscopy via chirp rheometry. We encode compact fractional viscoelastic models as causal convolutional features derived from the Boltzmann superposition principle, and we jointly fit multi-temperature chirp records using sparse variational Gaussian process regression. The model infers horizontal shift factors, constitutive parameters, and an observational-noise scale directly from time-domain stress-strain signals measured in the linear viscoelastic regime, without first extracting frequency-domain spectra or manually shifting separate curves. For synthetic Fractional Maxwell data, the method recovers the generating constitutive law from a prescribed model library and latent shifts over stress-noise levels from 3% to 25%. Applied to a DGEBA-IPDA epoxy dataset spanning the glass-transition regime, the pooled likelihood distinguishes competing fractional rheology models using the Bayesian information criterion. These results recast TTS master-curve construction as probabilistic inference over latent time rescaling and linear viscoelasticity, while also identifying limitations, such as homoscedastic noise and weakly informative spectral regimes.

title: Contrastive Regularization of Machine Learning Potentials
title_zh: 机器学习潜力的对比正则化
summary: 机器学习模型越来越多地被训练为回归器，然后部署为生成器，从语言模型到学习模拟器。在这种情况下，保留数据的准确性几乎不能说明模型在采样时产生的分布。我们研究这个问题，其中正确的分布是由第一原理确定的，在机器学习原子间势（MLIP）中，通过最小化密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力的均方误差（MSE）来训练，然后用于运行分子模拟。 MSE 永远不会限制势所定义的玻尔兹曼分布，因此 MLIP 可以匹配保留的 DFT 数据，并且在采样时仍然会漂移到破坏其热力学的虚假最小值。
abstract: arXiv:2606.31660v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly trained as regressors and then deployed as generators, from language models to learned simulators. In this setting, accuracy on held-out data says little about the distribution a model produces when it is sampled. We study this problem where the correct distribution is fixed by first principles, in machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained by minimizing the mean squared error (MSE) on density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces, then used to run molecular simulations. The MSE never constrains the Boltzmann distribution that the potential defines, so an MLIP can match held-out DFT data and still drift, when sampled, into spurious minima that corrupt its thermodynamics. Building on the variational principle of statistical physics, we introduce Contrastive Regularized MSE (CRMSE), a post-training step in which the potential acts as its own energy-based model and learns to reproduce the distribution it generates, without any new DFT data. On molecules from the MD17 benchmark, CRMSE restores physical sampling and recovers DFT free-energy profiles, while keeping energy and force errors within chemical accuracy. Our results suggest that a model meant to be sampled must be trained on the distribution it produces, not only for pointwise accuracy.

title: AtomMOF: All-Atom Flow Matching for MOF-Adsorbate Structure Prediction
title_zh: AtomMOF：用于 MOF 吸附结构预测的全原子流匹配
summary: 金属有机框架（MOF）是用于直接空气捕获等应用的有前景的材料，其性能取决于吸附物在框架内的结合方式。因此，准确预测 MOF 吸附物构型对于筛选候选材料非常重要。然而，传统方法的计算成本很高，并且需要已知的主体结构，而现有的生成模型依赖于刚体假设，并且没有明确地模拟吸附物。我们引入了 AtomMOF，这是一种可扩展的全原子流匹配模型，可以从离散的构建块和吸附物中联合预测 MOF 吸附物结构。
abstract: arXiv:2602.07351v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising materials for applications such as direct air capture, where performance depends on how adsorbates bind within the framework. Accurately predicting MOF-adsorbate configurations is therefore important for screening candidate materials. However, traditional approaches are computationally expensive and require a known host structure, while existing generative models rely on rigid-body assumptions and do not explicitly model adsorbates. We introduce AtomMOF, a scalable all-atom flow-matching model that jointly predicts MOF-adsorbate structures from discrete building blocks and adsorbates. Built on a Diffusion Transformer with a building block-based pairwise attention bias, AtomMOF operates in an unconstrained all-atom space and exhibits clear scaling behavior. To improve the structural validity of flexible all-atom models, we also propose Feynman-Kac (FK) steering with machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). On the BW dataset, AtomMOF achieves a 58.17% relative increase in match rate and a 31.84% relative reduction in RMSD compared with prior work. MLIP-guided steering further improves validity by 28.7% and reduces formation energy error by 86.5%. On ODAC25, AtomMOF generates adsorption configurations faster than GCMC and, when combined with MLIP relaxation, identifies lower-energy configurations than those in the reference dataset.

title: Machine Learning Accelerated Simulation of Charge Regulation Effects
title_zh: 电荷调节效应的机器学习加速模拟
summary: 许多溶剂化材料，从纳米粒子到聚电解质，通过表面基团的解离或缔合获得电荷，这种现象称为电荷调节（CR）。最近的方法使用混合电荷调节蒙特卡罗（CR-MC）/分子动力学（MD）来进化系统，同时动态调整表面基团上的电荷。然而，这种方法的计算成本很高，因为蒙特卡罗采样的成本与随附的 MD 一样高。在这项工作中，我们引入了电荷调节机器学习（CR-ML），这是一种图注意力网络，可以根据瞬时构型、表面基团的解离常数和溶液条件来预测每个表面位点的电离概率。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many solvated materials, from nanoparticles to polyelectrolytes, acquire charge through the dissociation or association of surface groups, a phenomenon known as charge regulation (CR). Recent methods use hybrid charge regulation Monte Carlo (CR-MC)/molecular dynamics (MD) to evolve the system while dynamically adjusting charges on the surface groups. However, this approach is computationally expensive, as Monte Carlo sampling can be as costly as the accompanying MD. In this work, we introduce charge regulation machine learning (CR-ML), a graph attention network that predicts the ionization probability of every surface site from the instantaneous configuration, the dissociation constant of surface groups, and the solution conditions. We show that CR-ML reproduces the equilibrium conformations and degree of ionization obtained with CR-MC for a hydrophobic polyanion. We further test CR-ML on the more complex system of two nanoparticles mediated by a polyelectrolyte, where it accurately predicts the charge asymmetry that develops between the two particles. Across these systems, CR-ML updates charges an order of magnitude faster than CR-MC while accurately reproducing its equilibrium properties. This framework opens a path toward large-scale simulations of charge-regulating materials for understanding and designing their responsive behavior.

title: QuantumMatterExplorer: An Autonomous Agent for the Discovery of Quantum Many-Body Phases of Matter
title_zh: QuantumMatterExplorer：用于发现物质的量子多体相的自主代理
summary: 绘制新量子哈密顿量的相图需要在每一步都进行专家判断：测量哪些可观测值，在参数空间中的何处进行计算，或者如何将真实的顺序与有限尺寸的人工制品分开。我们引入了 QuantumMatterExplorer，这是一个自主代理，它仅将哈密顿量及其参数范围作为输入，并返回从其自己的数值模拟中获得的相图。该代理建立在大型语言模型的基础上，旨在进行长期推理、维护持久的书面计划并驱动一组计算工具，并通过密度矩阵重整化群 (DMRG) 计算与独立精确对角化进行交叉检查。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32001v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mapping the phase diagram of a new quantum Hamiltonian demands expert judgement at every step: which observables to measure, where in parameter space to compute, or how to separate genuine order from finite-size artefacts. We introduce QuantumMatterExplorer, an autonomous agent that takes only a Hamiltonian and its parameter ranges as input and returns a phase diagram obtained from its own numerical simulations. The agent is built on a large language model and is designed to reason over a long horizon, maintain a persistent written plan, and drive a set of computational tools, with density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations cross-checked against independent exact diagonalization. The agent combines a large language model with persistent planning, a library of expert computational-physics skills, and density-matrix renormalization group calculations validated against independent exact diagonalization. It adaptively selects quantities to evaluate, refines parameter scans, and performs finite-size analyses as evidence accumulates. After validating the approach on Hamiltonians with known transitions, we challenge it with a frustrated bilinear-biquadratic spin-1 chain with single-ion anisotropy, whose two-dimensional phase diagram was published only recently and is unlikely to appear in any training corpus. Given no hint about the expected physics, the agent proposes which observables to probe, and identifies candidate Néel, Haldane and dimerized phases, in broad agreement with the reference phase diagram. It also detects incommensurate correlations and infers the frustration-dependent geometry of the phase boundaries, all within an eight-hour compute budget. These results open a practical route to the autonomous computational discovery of new phases of quantum matter.

title: Combining Simulations and Spectroscopy to Design Protective Coatings on Sulfide Solid Electrolytes
title_zh: 结合模拟和光谱学设计硫化物固体电解质的保护涂层
summary: 硫化物固体电解质由于其高锂离子电导率和良好的加工性能而对全固态电池有吸引力，但其实际应用受到电化学不稳定性和湿气引起的降解的限制。分子表面涂层提供了一种可扩展的策略来提高耐湿性和界面稳定性，但对控制表面相互作用的分子水平因素的了解有限。通过将机器学习潜力实现的大规模原子模拟与目标实验相结合，我们提出了一个用于设计 Li₆PS₅Cl (LPSCl) 分子涂层的综合框架。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sulfide solid electrolytes are attractive for all-solid-state batteries because of their high Li-ion conductivity and favorable processability, but their practical use is limited by electrochemical instability and moisture-induced degradation. Molecular surface coatings offer a scalable strategy to improve humidity tolerance and interfacial stability, yet there is limited understanding of the molecular-level factors governing surface interactions. By combining large-scale atomistic simulations enabled by a machine-learning potential with targeted experiments, we present a comprehensive framework for designing molecular coatings on Li₆PS₅Cl (LPSCl). Using a PET-MAD interatomic potential fine-tuned on an r²SCAN reference dataset covering LPSCl surfaces, molecular adsorbates, and their interactions, we model surface adsorption of carboxylic (CA), sulfonic (SA), and phosphonic (PA) acids with alkyl chains of varying lengths and the interaction of these coated surfaces with water at finite temperature. The simulations show that lithiated head groups generally exhibit more favorable adsorption energies. Impedance spectroscopy shows that the lithiated coatings maintain 40--55% of the initial ionic conductivity after powder processing. While adsorption strength is largely controlled by head-group chemistry and lithiation state, coating morphology depends primarily on alkyl-chain length and surface coverage. In particular, long-chain lithiated carboxylates form dense, brush-like hydrophobic layers that reduce water access to reactive Li surface sites, with protection setting in at a coating thickness of approximately 0.8 nm. Consistent with these predictions, longer carboxylate chains suppress H₂S evolution more effectively. Because thicker coatings also hinder Li-ion transport, intermediate chain lengths offer the best balance between moisture protection and ionic conductivity.

title: Probing the limits of forward screening and inverse design of crystal materials
title_zh: 探索晶体材料正向筛选和逆向设计的极限
summary: 晶体材料的设计要么是通过筛选已知晶体的目标特性，要么是通过生成具有该特性的新晶体来设计。两条路线都是根据已知晶体的公共数据库进行判断的，但这些数据库对同一晶体的命名不同。最近的生成和自主发现活动宣布的几种新材料已被证明是已知的阶段或它们的密切变体。两条路线的极限仍未测量。在这里，我们通过将 55 个数据库中的晶体按结构匹配到一个包含 1460 万个晶体和 1.318 亿个属性值的自扩展数据库中来探索它们，每个数据库都可以追溯到其来源。只有 4.5% 的晶体属性对具有价值。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal materials are designed either by screening known crystals for a target property or by generating new crystals with that property. Both routes are judged against public databases of known crystals, but these databases name the same crystal differently. Several materials announced as new by recent generative and autonomous discovery campaigns have since proved to be known phases or close variants of them. The limits of both routes remain unmeasured. Here we probe them by matching the crystals of 55 databases by structure into one self-extending database of 14.6 million crystals and 131.8 million property values, each traced to its source. Only 4.5% of its crystal-property pairs carry a value. To fill the empty pairs, we developed CGTNet, an equivariant graph transformer with state-of-the-art accuracy on several tasks of two public benchmarks. Trained on each task, it forms a library of property models whose predictions we release. The reach of forward screening has been underestimated. Known crystals hold tens of thousands of ultra-incompressible candidates without a recorded bulk modulus, and a post hoc audit of synthesis evidence finds among them ReN2, whose bulk modulus was measured at 428 GPa. The novelty claimed for inverse design has been overestimated. At an equal verification budget, a stiffness-conditioned generator returned more stiff hits than screening (100 versus 55), but all contained osmium and 82 repeated recorded compositions. Integrating and completing the databases of known crystals therefore moves the limits of both routes: it widens what screening can reach and sets the reference against which generated crystals are judged new.

title: Near-field maps of topological edge states of molecular aggregates
title_zh: 分子聚集体拓扑边缘态的近场图
summary: 自组装二维分子聚集体为工程激子态（包括拓扑非平凡边缘态）提供了一个通用平台。然而，这些边缘态很难用光学方法探测：它们的远场跃迁强度较弱，并且远场光谱无法揭示激发是否局部在边缘。对于由两个具有真正复杂的跃迁偶极子的分子亚晶格组成的聚集体，我们表明空间分辨近场光谱编码了这些状态的完整空间结构。由此产生的近场地图并不反映现场人口，而是表现出强烈的不均匀、类似干扰的特征。我们证明，卷积神经网络可以从这些图中重建本征态的复展开系数，并且这种重建对于大量随机噪声具有鲁棒性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32287v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Self-assembled two-dimensional molecular aggregates provide a versatile platform for engineering excitonic states, including topologically nontrivial edge states. However, these edge-states are difficult to probe optically: they have weak far-field transition strengths, and far-field spectra do not reveal whether an excitation is localized at the edge. For an aggregate consisting of two sublattices of molecules with genuinely complex transition dipoles, we show that spatially resolved near-field spectroscopy encodes the full spatial structure of these states. The resulting near-field maps do not mirror the site populations, but instead exhibit strongly nonuniform, interference-like features. We demonstrate that a convolutional neural network can reconstruct the complex expansion coefficients of the eigenstates from these maps, and that this reconstruction is robust against substantial random noise.

title: Realization of a Synthetic Hall Torus with a Topological Charge Pump in a Spinor Bose-Einstein Condensate
title_zh: 在旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态中利用拓扑电荷泵实现合成霍尔环面
summary: 我们报告了使用旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体合成霍尔环面的第一个实验实现，该凝聚体被限制在具有原位成像的环形陷阱中。通过拉曼和微波场循环耦合三个超精细自旋态，我们在合成维度中施加了一个周期边界条件，该条件与真实空间环阱一起实现了环形几何形状，其中合成磁通量穿透表面。这种通量诱导方位密度调制，其周期性由量化的环形通量唯一决定，这是霍尔环面的标志。然后，我们通过绝热地改变通过环面的轴向通量来实现拓扑电荷泵，从而诱导原子的量化方位向传输。
abstract: arXiv:2602.14549v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the first experimental realization of a synthetic Hall torus using a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a ring-shaped trap with in situ imaging. By cyclically coupling three hyperfine spin states via Raman and microwave fields, we impose a periodic boundary condition in the synthetic dimension, which, together with a real-space ring trap, realizes a toroidal geometry with synthetic magnetic flux penetrating the surface. This flux induces azimuthal density modulations whose periodicity is uniquely determined by the quantized toroidal flux, a hallmark of the Hall torus. We then implement a topological charge pump by adiabatically varying an axial flux through the torus, inducing quantized azimuthal transport of the atoms. We further investigate the onset of these modulations as the system transitions from cylindrical to toroidal topology. Our results establish a versatile platform for exploring quantum Hall physics and topological phenomena in synthetic curved spaces.

title: Theoretical prediction of masses and decay constants of bottomonium and bottom-charm mesons with spin dependent Cornell potential
title_zh: 具有自旋相关康奈尔势的底离子和底魅力介子的质量和衰变常数的理论预测
summary: 我们使用一阶微扰理论中的自旋相关康奈尔势来研究介子的束缚态谱和衰变特性。获得了能量特征值的解析表达式，并通过考虑自旋无关极限对模型进行了验证，结果再现了标准康奈尔势谱，并与基于人工神经网络、渐近迭代法和矩阵 Numerov 方法的现有计算表现出良好的一致性。自旋相关势的参数是通过将所得分析质谱方程与实验数据拟合来确定的。然后使用这些参数来计算低位量子态的底部介子和底部魅力介子的质量和衰变特性。
abstract: We investigate the bound-state spectrum and decay properties of mesons using a spin-dependent Cornell potential within first-order perturbation theory. Analytical expressions for the energy eigenvalues are obtained, and the model is validated by considering the spin-independent limit, where the results reproduce the standard Cornell potential spectrum and show good agreement with existing calculations based on artificial neural networks, the asymptotic iteration method, and the matrix Numerov approach. The parameters of the spin-dependent potential are determined by fitting the resulting analytical mass-spectrum equation to experimental data. These parameters are then used to calculate the masses and decay properties of bottomonium and bottom-charm mesons for low-lying quantum states. For the bottomonium states, an average percentage absolute deviation of approximately 0.15% from the experimental masses is obtained, demonstrating an improvement over several previous theoretical predictions while the bottom-charm masses aligned with other theoretic values in the literature. The vector and pseudoscalar decay constants are calculated from the corresponding wave functions at the origin and exhibit a decreasing behavior with increasing principal quantum number, The pseudoscalar di-photon and vector leptonic decay widths are subsequently evaluated using the leading and first-order Van Royen–Weisskopf formula. The predicted decay constants are found to be generally consistent with available experimental data and previous theoretical results. Furthermore, incorporating the QCD running strong coupling at appropriate renormalization scales improves the description of the decay properties, emphasizing the sensitivity to the wave function at the origin. The results demonstrate that the perturbative spin-dependent Cornell potential provides a simple and effective phenomenological framework for describing the mass spectra and decay properties of bottomonium and bottom-charm mesons.

title: Sub-monolayer tracking of molecular states at buried interfaces
title_zh: 掩埋界面分子态的亚单层跟踪
summary: 新兴技术的现象源于埋藏界面处的新颖分子状态。然而，在大多数情况下，定量解决这些特征是不可能的。共振散射已证明对这些局部状态敏感，但由于缺乏准确的解释模型而受到限制。我们利用机器学习 (ML) 优化的光学模型来分析分子薄膜的偏振共振软 X 射线散射 (RSoXS)。这项新分析建立了分子取向、化学特性和堆积状态作为深度函数的直接定量解释，具有亚单层分辨率——通过光学模型锁定能量和偏振，超出了衍射极限。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phenomena responsible for emerging technologies originate from novel molecular states at buried interfaces. Yet quantitatively resolving these features is out of reach in most cases. Resonant scattering has demonstrated sensitivity to these local states but is limited due to a lack of accurate interpretive models. We leverage a machine learning (ML)-optimized optical model to analyze polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) from molecular thin films. This new analysis establishes the direct and quantitative interpretation of molecular orientation, chemical identity and packing states as a function of depth with sub-monolayer resolution - reaching beyond the diffraction limit via locking energy and polarization through the optical model. From our analysis, we discover a gradient evolution of molecular orientation and packing emerging from the interface, indicative of competing surface versus bulk growth dynamics and contradicting hypotheses of substrate patterning. This nondestructive insight into buried interfacial formation and final state opens possibilities in controlling interfacial states and phenomena in next-generation technologies.

title: Approximating the Gibbs Measure of Spherical Spin Glasses to Within o(N⁻¹/²) in the Replica Symmetric Phase
title_zh: 复制对称相中球形自旋玻璃的吉布斯测度近似于 o(N⁻1/2) 范围内
summary: 我们研究了弱外场中混合球形自旋玻璃在复制对称相中的磁化矢量。我们推导出磁化强度的坐标展开，其中包括对二次近似的领先三次修正，每个坐标的误差为 o(N⁻1/2)。我们还证明了全向量的相应高矩界。最后，我们的配套论文将这些估计应用于通过将倾斜球形自旋玻璃限制在 TAP 临界点周围的窄带内而获得的有效哈密顿量。由此产生的锐近似是为归一化 Wasserstein 精度不足的应用而设计的，包括通过随机定位进行的总变异采样。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the magnetization vector of mixed spherical spin glasses in a weak external field, in the replica symmetric phase. We derive a coordinatewise expansion of the magnetization which includes the leading cubic correction to the quadratic approximation, with an error that is o(N⁻¹/²) per coordinate. We also prove a corresponding high-moment bound for the full vector. Finally, our companion paper applies these estimates to the effective Hamiltonian obtained by restricting a tilted spherical spin glass to a narrow band around a TAP critical point. The resulting sharp approximation is designed for applications in which normalized Wasserstein accuracy is insufficient, including total-variation sampling by stochastic localization.

title: Electronic band structure reconstruction in Ni intercalated ZrTe₂
title_zh: Ni插层ZrTe2中的电子能带结构重构
summary: 过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）中大范德华能隙的填充通常会导致晶格和电子不稳定，从而预示着丰富的现象学的开始。受先前宏观测量结果的启发，我们采用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 研究了 TMD ZrTe2 和 Ni 插层 ZrTe2 (NiₓZrTe2, xapprox 0.05) 的电子结构。我们很容易在 NiₓZrTe2 中识别出两个平带，很可能与局域 Ni 衍生的 3d 态相关，结合能约为 0.7 eV 和约 1.2 eV。
abstract: arXiv:2601.02647v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The filling of the large van der Waals gap in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides (TMDs) often leads to lattice and electronic instabilities, which prelude the onset of a rich phenomenology. Motivated by previous results from macroscopic measurements, we investigate the electronic structure of the TMDs ZrTe₂ and Ni intercalated ZrTe₂ (NiₓZrTe₂, xapprox 0.05) employing angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). We readily identify in NiₓZrTe₂ two flat bands, most likely associated with localized Ni-derived 3d-states, at about approx-0.7 eV and approx-1.2 eV in binding energy. More significantly, at low T, we identify an electronic structure reconstruction in NiₓZrTe₂, which halves the electronic periodicity along the kz direction. This is reminiscent of a commensurate band folding with wave-vector q=(0,0,π). A mean-field model for a charge density wave (CDW) transition driven by interband hole-hole interactions is solved with inputs from the experimentally determined electronic band structure. Comparison between theory and experiments unveils a CDW transition in NiₓZrTe₂, for which the gap opens above the Fermi level. Our findings invite further investigation into the structural properties of intercalated ZrTe₂.

title: Electronic structure of a persistent excitonic fluid far beyond the Mott limit
title_zh: 远超莫特极限的持久激子流体的电子结构
summary: 通常预计激子在高光激发密度下会不稳定，因为屏蔽削弱了电子空穴吸引力。然而，最近的研究挑战了这一范式，表明强光泵浦产生的激子即使在粒子数反转发生之后也可以保持稳定。在这里，我们利用二维杂化钙钛矿的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，为这种高密度激子态提供了直接证据，其特征是独特的墨西哥帽色散。值得注意的是，这种激子带重建的持续时间比光学相干时间长几个数量级，揭示了一种群体维持的电子结构，该结构可以很好地适应非相干状态。在激子波函数强烈重叠的密度下，激子共振也持续远远超出光学饱和度。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons are conventionally expected to destabilize at high photoexcitation densities, as screening weakens the electron-hole attraction. Recent studies, however, challenge this paradigm, suggesting that excitons generated by strong optical pumping can remain stable even beyond the onset of population inversion. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy on 2D hybrid perovskites, we provide direct evidence for such a high-density excitonic state, characterized by a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion. Remarkably, this excitonic band reconstruction endures for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, revealing a population-sustained electronic structure that survives well into the incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance also persists far beyond optical saturation, at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. Our findings reveal a long-lived, high-density quantum fluid of excitons with characteristics reminiscent of a BCS condensate, an electronic structure markedly different from that of the dilute limit.

title: Entanglement Asymmetry and Asymmetry Contour under Boundary Symmetry Breaking
title_zh: 边界对称破缺下的纠缠不对称和不对称轮廓
summary: 我们研究了对称破缺边界磁场如何影响横向场 Ising 模型中的磁化强度和 Rényi-2 纠缠不对称性 (EA)。对于基态，磁化在有序相和无序相中表现出性质不同的行为。 EA 还表现出相位相关行为，这一点可以通过本工作中导出的下限和上限很好地捕获。在临界状态下，磁化强度和 EA 的行为在质量上与相关设置的场论预测一致。我们还研究了边界淬灭动力学，发现磁化强度以与最大准粒子速度一致的速度从边界传播到本体中。相比之下，由于EA是一个子系统集成量，其空间结构无法直接解析。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32733v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how symmetry-breaking boundary magnetic fields affect magnetization and Rényi-2 entanglement asymmetry (EA) in the transverse-field Ising model. For the ground state, magnetization exhibits qualitatively distinct behaviors in the ordered and disordered phases. EA also exhibits phase-dependent behavior, which is well captured by the lower and upper bounds derived in this work. In the critical regime, both magnetization and EA exhibit behavior qualitatively consistent with the field-theoretical predictions for a related setup. We also study boundary-quench dynamics and find that magnetization propagates from the boundary into the bulk with a velocity consistent with the maximum quasiparticle velocity. In contrast, because EA is a subsystem-integrated quantity, its spatial structure is not directly resolved. We therefore introduce the asymmetry contour, a contour-like finite-difference quantity that provides a spatially resolved characterization of the symmetry-breaking information encoded in the reduced density matrix. The resulting contour is complementary to the local magnetization, retaining sensitivity to nonlocal many-body correlations while its dynamics also reflects the underlying quasiparticle propagation. These results show how EA and its contour can provide complementary information-theoretic characterizations of symmetry breaking and its spatial structure.

title: Heat current and noise in a point-like junction between normal metal and fractional quantum hall edge state with ν = 1/3
title_zh: 普通金属和分数量子霍尔边缘态（ν = 1/3）之间的点状结中的热流和噪声
summary: 在这项研究中，我们研究了填充因子 ν = 1/3 时通过分数量子霍尔体系中的收缩耦合的两个边缘态之间的热流相关性。这种配置允许我们将系统映射到具有局部杂质的相互作用的 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体上，其中相互作用参数的值为 κ = 1/2。该特定参数值使得能够应用参考离子化方法。通过求解参考哈密顿量，我们计算热流并评估有限频率热自相关函数和互相关函数。我们的结果揭示了频率的不对称行为，分别对应于吸收和发射噪声。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31893v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we investigate heat current correlations between two edge states coupled through a constriction in the fractional quantum Hall regime at filling factor ν = 1/3. This configuration allows us to map the system onto an interacting Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid with a local impurity, where the interaction parameter takes the value κ = 1/2. This specific parameter value enables the application of the refermionization method. By solving the refermionized Hamiltonian, we compute the heat current and evaluate the finite-frequency heat auto- and cross-correlation functions. Our results reveal asymmetric behavior with frequency, corresponding to absorption and emission noise, respectively. Furthermore, we examine several limiting cases, including low- and high-temperature limits as well as strong- and weak-backscattering regimes. In the weak backscattering regime, the Lorenz number approaches 4L₀ at high voltage, suggesting a rescaling of the Wiedemann-Franz law due to interactions. A detailed study of the heat current fluctuations has made it possible to identify and derive expressions for the dominant contribution in the various regimes of interest, and to reveal the predominance of partition noise.

title: Heterogeneous superconductivity emerging from a charge-stripe state in kagome lattices
title_zh: Kagome 晶格中电荷条纹态出现的异质超导性
summary: 电荷密度波（CDW）和超导长期以来被认为是相互竞争的秩序。然而，最近的成就表明，这两种集体电子现象之间的相互作用可能更加令人困惑，它们的合作会产生新的现象。在这里，我们报告了 Kagome 超导体 CsV3Sb5-xSnx 的一个独特案例，其中超导特性按照 CDW 顺序的形式演化。当 CsV3Sb5 中的三 Q CDW 在 xc = 0.07 处转变为短程条纹状 CDW 时，超导特性随之发生突然变化。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity have long been recognized as competing orders. However, recent achievements establish that the interplay between these two collective electronic phenomena can be more perplexing, with emergent phenomena arising from their cooperation. Here we report a distinctive case of the kagome superconductors CsV3Sb5-xSnx, in which the characteristics of superconductivity evolve in accordance with the form of CDW order. As the triple-Q CDW in CsV3Sb5 transforms to a short-range stripelike CDW at xc = 0.07, a sudden change in superconducting properties occurs concomitantly. A combination of thermodynamic, electrical transport and scanning tunneling microscopy experiments reveals a heterogeneous superconducting state beyond xc: the superconducting gap exhibits pronounced spatial variation, in conformity with a distribution of critical temperature and the resulted superconducting precursor effects. Moreover, abundant normal fluid persists deep into the superconducting state, as evidenced by remnants of electronic specific heat and zero-energy quasiparticle interference. These observations are unrelated to the chemical inhomogeneity and residual strain effect introduced by Sn substitution. Instead, they emulate the phenomenology that a sign-changing superconducting order parameter is subject to strong pair-breaking scattering with the short-range charge stripes and hence reflect the unconventional nature of superconductivity developing inside the charge-stripe state.

title: Transparency-controlled multiple charge transfer in superconducting junctions with local shot-noise scanning tunneling spectroscopy
title_zh: 利用局部散粒噪声扫描隧道光谱在超导结中控制透明度控制的多重电荷转移

title_zh: 流动铁磁体中非平衡电子、声子和磁振子动力学的从头算旋量 Kadanoff-Baym 方法
